candidates.name: Routing regex constants module
candidates.testability: high (deterministic regex/list values; trivial import-compat + value smoke tests)
candidates.monkeypatch_concern: tests/unit/test_brain_chat_hygiene.py:182 does session_mod._AGENT_PATTERNS read-only access. As long as session.py re-exports it (assignment), session_mod._AGENT_PATTERNS resolves. No tests monkeypatch._AGENT_PATTERNS to a new value, so re-export is sufficient.
risk_factors: Tests import names directly from brain_v9.core.session — re-export is mandatory.
agent/loop.py:2224 has its OWN _LEAK_TAIL_RE on a class — same name but unrelated; no impact.
session_query_predicates.py already keeps its own copy of _CODE_ANALYSIS_PATH_RE (post-B7-03) — safe; does not depend on session.py copy.
candidates.justification: Highest-value, lowest-risk candidate. Pure data, no self/cls coupling, follows B7-02/B7-03 strangler pattern (extract+reexport). Real ~95-line reduction. Tests are simple value/identity assertions plus an import-compat shim test. No protected paths involved.

candidates.name: _fmt_* formatter classmethod bundle
candidates.reexport_required_in_session: BrainSession would need 17 thin classmethod shims OR import-and-attach pattern; tests reference some via instance methods
candidates.circular_import_risk: medium (helpers may need types from session)
candidates.testability: medium (each formatter takes a structured payload, deterministic outputs)
risk_factors: Methods are bound to BrainSession class; moving requires wrapper shims or rebinding.
Possible coupling via ChatMetrics enrichments (need careful audit).
Higher coordination cost vs C1; better as a follow-up ticket once routing constants are out.
candidates.justification: Strong long-term candidate but bigger implementation surface than this round warrants. Right after C1 ships.

candidates.name: SLASH_COMMANDS dict alone
risk_factors: Tiny payoff alone; better bundled with routing constants OR deferred.
candidates.recommendation: DEFER (or fold into a future combined ticket)
candidates.justification: Real but small. Doing it standalone yields too little reduction to justify a strangler ticket; doing it with routing constants would mix unrelated concerns.

candidates.name: _render_* + _format_* small classmethod bundle
candidates.reexport_required_in_session: rebind as classmethods on BrainSession or import-and-attach
risk_factors: Like C2, needs rebinding pattern; requires deciding between 'free helper functions in new module' vs 'classmethods'.
Best done after C1 lands and C2 paves the rebinding pattern.
candidates.justification: Reasonable but better paired with C2.

candidates.name: _sanitize_llm_chat_response single staticmethod
risk_factors: Sits inside the LLM routing flow — high-touch area; sanitiser bug = visible regression.
Single-symbol module is justifiable but smaller than C1.
candidates.justification: Cleaner one-shot extraction but lower reduction than C1 and lives in the routing core, increasing review surface.

candidates.name: Path constants bundle (_STATE_PATH and friends)
candidates.testability: low (monkeypatch correctness is hard to assert)
risk_factors: Multiple existing tests monkeypatch session_mod._STATE_PATH and friends; if session.py only re-imports the new module, in-file callsites must reference the variable through the re-exported name AND tests must patch the new module.
High likelihood of subtle test breakage for trivial reduction.
candidates.justification: Tiny payoff combined with real monkeypatch hazard. Wrong shape for a strangler ticket.

candidates.name: Tool01 subsystem (_tool01_*)
risk_factors: Tool01 is part of the security/permission gate domain; touching it is OFF-LIMITS per ticket rules (protected: tool permission/permission gate adjacent).
candidates.justification: Out of scope per task hard rules (Tool01 / permission gate adjacent).
